summary: Accumulates a byte value into a caller-provided object: adds the low byte of a1 to the byte at offset +94 of a2, then returns a1 unchanged. Operates purely on caller registers (a1 in ebx, a2 in edi); no object or field identity is established in the packet.

operations.description: Add a1 to the byte at a2 + 94 in place (byte accumulator field of the object pointed to by a2).
Return a1 unchanged after the byte increment.

unresolved: The object at a2 and the semantic role of field +94 (an accumulator) are not established; the packet provides no struct type or field evidence.
The low-byte truncation of a1 is a decompiler artifact of the byte add; the upper bits of a1 are not part of the stored value.
Why the function returns a1 (its input) rather than the accumulated field is unexplained by the packet.
